title: The Missing Link
subtitle: Find customers with no orders — ghost accounts!
conceptSummary: LEFT JOIN keeps ALL rows from the left table, even if there's no match in the right table (those get NULL).

dialogue.text: We need to find customers who are in our database but have NEVER placed an order. Those 'ghost' accounts might have been created to steal discount codes!
LEFT JOIN keeps every customer, even ones with no orders. Their order columns will be NULL. Filter for NULL order_id.

teachMoment.title: LEFT JOIN: Keep All From Left
teachMoment.body:
LEFT JOIN keeps all rows from the LEFT table:

SELECT c.name, o.order_id
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

Customers with no orders get NULL in order columns.
Filter with IS NULL to find the unmatched ones!

task.instruction: Find all customers who have NEVER placed an order. Use LEFT JOIN and filter for NULL order_id.

hints.text: Use LEFT JOIN so all customers appear. Then WHERE o.order_id IS NULL finds the ones with no match.

winDialogue.text: Interesting... all customers have orders in this cleaned dataset. But in the raw logs, there were ghost accounts that have since been deleted. Someone covered their tracks!
The data was cleaned. By the mastermind. That means we need World 4 — the Cleanup Crew — to detect what was erased.

storyBeat: Someone cleaned the database to remove ghost accounts. The act of cleaning is itself evidence. In World 4, you'll learn to detect data manipulation through patterns in 'cleaned' data.
